editorial: When a lightning‑storm of paranoia grips a high‑stakes intelligence report you feel your pulse racing. Atlas blends the grit of a counterterrorism dossier with uncanny AI dread, making every interrogation feel like a chess match against an unseen opponent. Joaquin Phoenix delivers a near‑monologue performance, his restrained eyes cracking only at the final reveal. If you thrive on heart‑pounding, cerebral thrillers that make you question tech and trust, this nonstop ride will grip you. Some pacing hiccups creep into the final act, but the stakes never drop.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
